email.footer: You're receiving this because you have a Companion account.
email.verify.subject: Verify your email
email.verify.line2: Confirm your email address to finish setting up your account.
email.verify.note: This link expires in 24 hours. If you didn't create a Companion account, you can ignore this email.
email.reset.subject: Reset your password
email.reset.line1: We received a request to reset your Companion password.
email.reset.note: This link expires in 15 minutes. If you didn't request a reset, no action is needed — your password hasn't changed.
email.reminder.subject: Upcoming pet care
email.reminder.intro: These health updates are coming due:
email.reminder.outro: Please take care of these at your earliest convenience.
email.emailChanged.subject: A change to your Companion email was requested
email.emailChanged.line1: Someone requested to change the email address on your Companion account to {email}. The change won't take effect until that address is verified.
email.emailChanged.line2: If you made this change, no action is needed — this notice is for your records.
email.emailChanged.line3: If you did not, someone else may have access to your account. Reset your password now to lock it back down.
email.passwordChanged.subject: Your Companion password was changed
email.passwordChanged.line1: Your Companion password was just changed.
email.passwordChanged.line2: If this was you, no action is needed.
email.passwordChanged.line3: If it wasn't, request a reset immediately — that will invalidate the current password.
